~ Grok can fetch your emails without you forwarding anything
~ Grok can check your calendar when you ask what's on today
~ Grok can organize your Notion without you describing the structure
~ You @mention the connector, Grok does the rest

The AI assistant category just shifted. Most competitors charge for this. Grok is making it the baseline.

Tesla Vision can deploy airbags up to 70 milliseconds earlier than conventional crash sensors.

70 milliseconds sounds small. It isn't.

At 60 mph, a car covers about 6 feet in 70 milliseconds. That's the difference between an airbag inflating before peak crash forces hit your body, or during.

How it works:

~ Conventional airbags wait for impact sensors to detect the crash, then fire
~ By design, the car is already in the collision before deployment starts
~ Tesla Vision predicts an unavoidable collision before contact and pre-fires deployment
~ Airbag is fully inflated before peak forces reach the driver

This is what Tesla means when it says vision-based safety isn't just about avoiding crashes. It's about surviving the ones that can't be avoided.

Per Tesla: this can be the difference between serious injury and walking away.

🚀 Starship V3: The Big Leap Forward

SpaceX just stacked the first full V3 Starship (Ship + Super Heavy booster) at Starbase! This isn’t just another iteration — it’s a major redesign built for full reusability, higher performance, and the real operational phase: orbital refueling, lunar landings, and Mars missions.

Key Differences from V2 (and earlier versions):

•  Engines: Raptor 3 Simpler, lighter, more powerful (~280 tf sea-level thrust vs ~230 tf for Raptor 2), with far less external plumbing and no need for heavy heat shielding on many areas. This boosts efficiency and reliability dramatically.
•  Size & Propellant Capacity Slightly taller (~5 ft / 1.5 m more) with stretched tanks for significantly more propellant. This enables much higher payload — up to 100+ tons to LEO in reusable mode (potentially 180–200+ tons in some configs), nearly tripling earlier capabilities.

•  Booster Upgrades

•  Only 3 larger grid fins (50% bigger, tougher) instead of 4.
•  Strengthened structure and longer propellant section.
•  Integrated hot-staging ring (no more separate ring dropping away).
•  Optimized for tower catches and rapid turnaround.
•  Ship (Upper Stage) Changes
•  9 engines total in some configs (vs 6 on V2).
•  Redesigned propellant systems, avionics, and energy storage for longer-duration missions.
•  Docking adapters and hardware ready for in-orbit propellant transfer.
•  Cleaner, lighter internal design — fewer pipes, more efficient.
•  Overall Philosophy
 V3 is a “clean sheet” evolution based on hard lessons from flights. It’s lighter, simpler, stronger, and built for production-scale operations rather than pure testing.
V3 marks the shift from experimental flights to the vehicle that will actually make Starship operational. First integrated test flight coming soon — this beast is going to change everything.

Starship is the vehicle to the moon and mars

The expansion shows Tesla continuing to strengthen its footprint across key regions in Japan.

Tesla FSD V14 handles a human hand signal flawlessly.

In a new clip shared by reddituser4049, the vehicle recognizes a hand gesture, stops and waits appropriately before continuing.

These small interactions matter more than raw highway driving. Real-world human behavior is unpredictable, and smooth communication between people and autonomous systems is one of the hardest parts of self-driving.

Moments like this show how much more natural FSD behavior is becoming.
